sentences.text: On March 2, 2026, Bumblethorpe Urgent Care documented a fall on ice, left knee pain 6/10, and an X-ray negative for fracture.
On March 9, 2026, Dr. Ambrose Thistlewaite of orthopedics documented a knee sprain and recommended physical therapy.
On March 16, 2026, Bumblethorpe Physical Therapy documented pain of 5/10 at visit 1.
On May 4, 2026, Bumblethorpe Physical Therapy documented pain of 4/10 at visit 2.
